checks.demonstration: Take the three nonzero binary vectors \(\mathcal R=\{(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)\}\), cosine similarity, and \(\tau=1\). Every feature has unit norm after normalization. For \(y=(1,0)\), the partition is \(e+1+e^{1/\sqrt2}\); for \(y=(1,1)\), it is \(e+2e^{1/\sqrt2}\). Their difference is \(e^{1/\sqrt2}-1>0\). Adding the zero vector with the paper’s zero-similarity convention adds the same constant to both. Thus even the finite binary construction permits unequal partitions. On an unbounded countable reference space, a bounded similarity can also make the counting-measure partition infinite.

To retain ordinary Bayes semantics, specify a reference measure with finite candidate partitions and include \(Z(y,\tau)\) in each likelihood; a common partition requires a separate symmetry assumption.

checks.location: AppendixC.1 Joint Keying,Length-Descending Iteration,and Persistent Counters
checks.claim: Boundary/length-ordered registry substitution is byte-identically reversible.
checks.explanation: Injectivity of the value-to-token registry does not imply injectivity of text substitution. A literal token in the original text becomes indistinguishable from an inserted token; the fallback does not recheck the completed round trip.
checks.demonstration: Take an initially empty registry whose first name token is \(\texttt{<NAME\_1>}\), and raw text “Alice wrote <NAME_1>.” A proposal maps Alice to <NAME_1>. Substitution gives “<NAME_1> wrote <NAME_1>.” Desanitizing gives “Alice wrote Alice.”, not the original. The alignment test can detect this, but the fallback still accepts the pair because Alice occurs in the raw input, and then constructs the same colliding text. There is only one mapping, so neither length ordering nor word boundaries helps. Persistent counters prevent collisions between newly allocated names; they do not prevent the next allocated token from occurring literally in the input. The round-trip identity therefore fails even with the stated registry qualifications.
checks.repair: Reserve and escape the placeholder namespace before substitution, or choose fresh tokens absent from the complete raw input and all relevant stored text. Make the fallback satisfy the same round-trip condition as the aligned branch. A span-preserving serialization with an explicit inverse is another valid construction.
checks.scope: This is a counterexample to the stated string-encoding guarantee. It does not establish a deployed privacy breach, a failure of every sanitized query, or an implementation defect in unavailable code.
